name: Avacyn's Judgment
oracle_text:
Madness {X}{R} (If you discard this card, discard it into exile. When you do, cast it for its madness cost or put it into your graveyard.)
Avacyn's Judgment deals 2 damage divided as you choose among any number of targets. If this spell's madness cost was paid, it deals X damage divided as you choose among those permanents and/or players instead.
blocked_sentences: Madness {X}{R} (If you discard this card, discard it into exile. When you do, cast it for its madness cost or put it into your graveyard.)
If this spell's madness cost was paid, it deals X damage divided as you choose among those permanents and/or players instead.

needs.what: A condition that reads whether the spell was cast for its madness cost ("if this spell's madness cost was paid"), usable in an `if` inside `spell_effects`, analogous to `evoked` / `kicked` / `overloaded`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `condition_keys` has `evoked`, `kicked`, `overloaded`, `cost_option`, but nothing for madness. `cast_from_exile` is the near miss and is not exact: any impulse-style permission that casts this card from exile would also satisfy it without the madness cost being paid. `_offer_cast` emits `madness=1` on the SPELL_CAST event but no condition reads it on resolution

needs.what: A madness cost containing {X}: the player chooses X when casting for madness (107.3, 702.35), and that X is carried on the stack item so `{"x": true}` in the spell's effects reads it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `replacements._offer_cast` builds `Cost(mana=card.madness)` and calls `stack.push_spell` without an `x`, so X defaults to 0 on every madness cast; a Madness {X}{R} card would always deal 0 damage when its madness cost was paid
